answer: Because the dune release is entered with every signature, the raven audit reveals the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, as each signer must be independent on the trellis graph and each risks its bond. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 5 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. The fee repeats 23 times over. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
